description: Every name or role BCRG attaches to a validator reward address, a funding address, or a node, one row per attribution. Tiers: AS1 a protocol or contract registry, AS2 a signed self-claim, AS3 an organization's own disclosure, AS4 a third-party label without a stated method, AS5 our own clustering. Classes: EVIDENCE when an AS1 to AS3 source states it, or two independent sources agree and one is AS4; INFERENCE when it follows from evidence but no source states it, and every AS5 result or AS4 label alone; NOT DETERMINED when the evidence does not settle it. A correction is a new row whose replaces field names the row it corrects. Nothing is edited silently.

attributions.statement: The P-Chain address of the key that runs BENQI's liquid staking contract sAVAX (0x2b2C81e08f1Af8835a78Bb2A90AE924ACE0eA4bE, on BENQI's contract list). The C-Chain account 0x565f0fe9715e3cb0df579f186c299d6707887e83 holds the contract's ROLE_DEPOSIT and ROLE_WITHDRAW: hasRole returns true for both at C-Chain block 96,557,985. The public key recovered from that account's signed sAVAX withdraw call 0x2259372f8f290e1c60e1df15d443d72e61179f78483891024624eb3f741cfc53 derives this P-Chain address, so one key controls both.
